ns2:course.label: Nature Society and Democracy
ns2:course.description: Students develop critical and analytic thinking about socially-induced environmental destruction and possible alternatives that could develop contemporary society into an ecologically responsible society. Same as PS 273. Prerequisite: SOC 100 or ECON 101 or PS 100 or NRES 104.
